reviews.x: These are so cute! Works for kids and adults. Super soft. No complaints from us. 😸 We are so happy with this purchase.

reviews.t: My only reason to not give this 5 stars is ...
reviews.x: My only reason to not give this 5 stars is they all ran small in size.  Maybe a majority of Asian heads are smaller in size in the Asia-region, but since I myself am Filipino and I found it to be tight.  I could not wear it longer than the time it takes me to get thru my skin cleaning routine.  I even gave the others to my kids (21-24 yo) and they found it tight.  It is very cute otherwise and does what it needs to do.
These made our spa party for a bunch of 8 year old perfect! They are so cute. fits just right. and great quality

reviews.t: Spa Party Girls loved them!  Age 9...
reviews.x: We had a small spa party for 9 year old girls and they all LOVED them.  Not too tight, very soft, and really cute on!  None of the girls had any issues with them, and some opted to keep them on most of the party.  Recommended!
I only received 4 headbands. Purple, black, pink and blue. The white was completely missing from the inclosed bag.
Girls loved them for their Spa party...super soft and cute.  Decent quality.

reviews.t: This set vs. Etude House Cat Hair Band
reviews.x: I forgot my regular facial headband (by Etude House) so I figured I'd get some replacements while I traveled.  These do not stand up in terms of quality. They were pretty tight on my head but I will admit my head is larger than most. The fabric was very thin, and the back elastic wasn't the best. They smelled really odd out of the bag also which made me feel weird about using these. Had to return.  However I can see how these would be great as party favors for kids and I would highly recommend i

What a joke of a product. If it's made for little kids, please freaking say so. The item barely fits my head and I have a small skull. I bought it as gifts for my girl friends and I already know it's not going to fit 1/2 of them. Can't return this item for sanitary reasons but what a disappointment.

reviews.t: Tweens love pretending to be cats? Who knew?
reviews.x: Bought as a Covid19 bribe for the packs of tweens living nearby. They seemed thrilled with the colors & ran off to try them on, leaving adults to do adulting things in a peaceful, tween free environment. Excellent bang for the buck!

My daughter and her cousins had an awesome time using these along with their face masks. I just wish they would come a little bigger in size and would hold the ears in shape. They did not have any complaints though.

reviews.t: Even cuter in person and very soft yet wonderful for holding the hair back from your face
reviews.x: These are just the cutest things! Even cuter in person and very soft yet wonderful for holding the hair back from your face. Lovely and whimsical and a good price! Love them! Thanks!
Soft & functional, but machine washing in a mesh bag pulls the ears wide open since they are not sewn. You get what you pay for. I will most likely buy again, though.
I got these for my 10 year old daughter and I to use while washing our faces. They are sized more for children, but I can get it around my head well enough.
I got these to wear for when I'm doing my makeup. Theyre really soft and really cute. Would buy again if I needed to!
I purchased these for me & my friends when we had a facial party amongst us 5. They're cute and we just loved them

reviews.t: The girls loved them and even the moms wanted one
reviews.x: These were a huge hit at my daughters spa party! The girls loved them and even the moms wanted one!!! So cute!!!
Super cute and decently soft ! A little tight on my head as I am an adult haha and I have a bigger head lol
This headband is amazing 10/10 it comes fast

I saw some people saying these headbands are too wide, but I kind of like the width. The width allows the headband to comfortably cover my ears when washing my face. Keeping it on for around 3 hours to wear, it does start to give me a headache. If you’re just using it to wash your face you should be fine (my head is around 23 inches). The quality is nice, the designs are pretty cute. I’d buy it again. I had to return other ones that were way too small and poorly made. I got these instead, it’s w

reviews.t: Great for use with k-beauty masks, as long as your kid doesn't steal them all
reviews.x: I bought these to use with my k-beauty masks, and I went for the multi-pack because my daughter was eyeing them and I didn't want her to steal my only one. Sure enough, she claimed all of them but 1 (I had to tell her that she had to leave me 1). These work great at holding your hair back when you are washing your face, and are super cute. My only issue is that the sizing is not uniform, so the purple one is tight even on my daughter, which is sad because it was the color she was most excited ab

I absolutely love these! They are perfect for giving yourself (or your friends) facials, because they keep hair out of your face. Also, they make great daytime headbands because they are so cute! Children and adults will enjoy wearing these for facials and for daily use. One of mine broke after about a year of wearing it, but overall they are pretty sturdy. Defiantly would purchase again.

reviews.t: Super cute, but best for smaller heads...
reviews.x: I purchased a set of these cat headbands for a backyard spa day with a few friends.  Overall, these headbands fit everyone, some better than others.  I could tell they were a little tight-fitting on a few of us (not me, since I'm petite and my head is on the smaller side...).  Overall, the quality is good and the price is right, but the sizing could be a bit more accommodating.

These are super cute and really soft. I think I have a normal size head, but these fit really tight, like I have to scrape it over my face to get it on my head. I'm hoping they'll stretch a little with use, because it's not very comfortable to wear longer than washing my face. I haven't tried a face mask yet, I don't really know if I could handle the pressure.

the reason why this isn't a 5/5 but a 4/5 is due to the fact you have to stretch it for a good minute so it doesn't cause you a headache but I love it and use to when I'm washing my face/doing a mask. This prevent traction alopecia of the hairline that is caused when washing your face and it makes sure my silk scarf/bonnet doesn't get wet as well.

These are cute! But much smaller than expected. If you have a large head, I don't recommend these. They do not have much stretch. The head band is thin, like it was made for a child. The material is very soft and the colors are as shown. The cat ears are attractive. They serve their purpose, but I would not buy then again.

claims.text: Customers frequently describe the headbands as cute and soft, and they are especially popular for spa parties and kids' gatherings.
Several reviewers find the sizing runs small or tight, with some noting they are better suited for children than adults.
Some customers report quality issues such as thin fabric, flimsy elastic, ears losing shape, or missing pieces.
Reviewers consider the set good value for the price and many say they would buy again.
